chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam narrated from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a neighbor of mine who died and left daughters, so he said: "The wealth belongs to them."

key_terms.الْمَالُ: the property or estate left behind

ai.seo_question: If a man dies and leaves only daughters, who inherits his wealth?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning inheritance when a deceased man leaves behind daughters. The Imam عليه السلام states that the estate belongs to them, indicating their entitlement to the inherited wealth in this case.
